issues.current_text: O Claude Mythos Preview, modelo de IA da Anthropic capaz de identificar e explorar vulnerabilidades em todos os principais sistemas operacionais e navegadores, provocou mobilização inédita no sistema financeiro global. O secretário do Tesouro americano, Scott Bessent, e o presidente do Federal Reserve, Jerome Powell, convocaram reunião de emergência com CEOs do Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Citigroup, Bank of America e Wells Fargo.
issues.previous_text: O secretário do Tesouro americano, Scott Bessent, e o presidente do Federal Reserve, Jerome Powell, convocaram CEOs do Citigroup, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, Wells Fargo e Goldman Sachs a uma reunião de emergência em Washington para discutir riscos cibernéticos do Mythos, modelo de cibersegurança da Anthropic divulgado na terça-feira.
issues.suggestion: This is the same event — Bessent/Powell emergency meeting with bank CEOs over Mythos. The April 12 draft adds the OpenBSD vulnerability and $100M credits, but the core story ran two days ago. Either cut the meeting angle entirely and focus only on the genuinely new details (OpenBSD flaw, Bank of England/Canada reactions, Glasswing expansion), or open with a single sentence like 'A reunião de emergência sobre o Mythos, noticiada na quarta, desencadeou reações em cadeia' and spend the paragraph on what's NEW.

issues.current_text: registros fiscais revelaram que a Sharetronic Data Technology, parceira de nuvem da Nvidia, adquiriu cerca de 300 servidores com processadores de IA proibidos no valor de US$92 milhões; as ações desabaram 20%.
issues.previous_text: a Sharetronic Data Technology, provedora de infraestrutura de IA sediada em Shenzhen, viu suas ações despencarem 20% depois que registros fiscais revelaram US$92 milhões em servidores com chips proibidos H100 e H200 da Nvidia, adquiridos via Super Micro (sob investigação federal por contrabando de chips para a China).
issues.suggestion: Nearly identical story — same $92M figure, same 20% stock drop, same fiscal records reveal. The April 10 edition actually had MORE detail (H100/H200 chip names, Super Micro connection, Bloomberg reporting it was 1/5 of total). Cut this entirely or, if it must stay, frame it as follow-up to what was already reported: e.g., 'A Sharetronic, cujas compras irregulares detalhamos na quarta, agora enfrenta...' and add only genuinely new developments.

issues.current_text: A empresa também vai vender globalmente o R1, humanóide de 123 cm e 27 kg, por cerca de US$4.100 pelo AliExpress — o primeiro robô humanóide à venda em uma grande plataforma de comércio eletrônico. A Unitree despachou mais de 5.500 unidades em 2025, contra cerca de 150 de cada concorrente ocidental.
issues.previous_text: a chinesa Unitree Robotics lança na próxima semana o R1 no mercado global via AliExpress: um robô humanoide de US$4.370, com 1,23 metro e capaz de dar cambalhotas.
issues.suggestion: Same R1/AliExpress story from two days ago, even with conflicting prices ($4,100 vs $4,370). The 5,500 units shipped stat and the 'first humanoid on a major e-commerce platform' framing are new angles but the core news is stale. Either cut the R1 detail and keep only the H1 speed record (which IS new), or acknowledge continuity: 'O R1 da Unitree, cuja venda global anunciamos na quarta, chega ao AliExpress por...' — but honestly the H1 speed record carries the paragraph alone.

issues.current_text: O secretário do Tesouro americano, Scott Bessent, e o presidente do Federal Reserve, Jerome Powell, convocaram reunião de emergência com CEOs do Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Citigroup, Bank of America e Wells Fargo.
issues.previous_text: O secretário do Tesouro americano, Scott Bessent, e o presidente do Federal Reserve, Jerome Powell, convocaram CEOs do Citigroup, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, Wells Fargo e Goldman Sachs a uma reunião de emergência em Washington
issues.suggestion: Almost word-for-word identical construction. Same officials, same banks (reordered), same 'reunião de emergência' phrasing. If the story must stay, at minimum rewrite to avoid the déjà vu: reference it as known context, don't re-describe it as fresh news.

issues.current_text: capaz de identificar e explorar vulnerabilidades em todos os principais sistemas operacionais e navegadores
issues.previous_text: identifica e explora vulnerabilidades em sistemas operacionais e navegadores
issues.suggestion: Same descriptor of Mythos repeated nearly verbatim. If the model must be re-introduced, vary the description — focus on the OpenBSD discovery specifically rather than the generic capability summary.

issues.current_text: registros fiscais revelaram que a Sharetronic Data Technology... as ações desabaram 20%
issues.previous_text: registros fiscais revelaram US$92 milhões... ações despencarem 20%
issues.suggestion: Same sentence structure: 'registros fiscais revelaram' + 'ações [desabaram/despencaram] 20%'. Even the synonyms (desabaram/despencarem) highlight how mechanical the repetition is.

issues.current_text: The newsletter leads with Anthropic (Mythos + Eric Boyd hire + Claude for Word) taking up the first two paragraphs.
issues.previous_text: April 11 led with Anthropic (CoreWeave deal + 65% market share). April 10 featured Anthropic (Mythos bank meeting) as a major story. April 9 led with Meta but had Anthropic (Managed Agents) as anchor.
issues.suggestion: Four consecutive editions leading with or heavily featuring Anthropic. Even if the news warrants it, readers will feel like they're reading an Anthropic company blog. Consider leading with a different angle — the Unitree speed record, the Japan chips subsidies, or the Iran collapse — and folding Anthropic updates into the middle of the piece.

issues.current_text: The geopolitical section covers Iran/Hormuz negotiations and developments.
issues.previous_text: April 11: Iran negotiations in Islamabad + Hormuz closed. April 10: Hormuz ceasefire test + Islamabad talks. April 9: Hormuz closure + Iran attacks.
issues.suggestion: Iran/Hormuz has appeared in every edition for at least 4 days. Today's has genuine news (21h collapse, destroyers crossing, commercial ships exiting, China MANPADS to Iran), so it's warranted — but acknowledge the arc instead of presenting each day's update as standalone. A single line like 'Após quatro dias de impasse' would signal to the reader that this is a developing saga, not a fresh story.

summary: Three stories (Mythos/bank CEO meeting, Sharetronic $92M chips, Unitree R1/AliExpress) are near-verbatim repeats from April 10. Anthropic has led or dominated four consecutive editions. Iran/Hormuz coverage is warranted but needs arc-awareness framing.
